test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Conquer
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Win**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Conquer"** means to take control of a place or people by military force, or to overcome a challenge or problem. (विजय प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Alexander the Great set out to conquer the Persian Empire.
 
 
 
• **"Win"** refers to achieving victory in a contest or competition, or to obtain something desired. (जीतना)
 
 
• **Example: **The team managed to win the championship after a tough game.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Win**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Attach** (लगाना): To fasten, join, or connect something.

 
 
• **Example:** Please attach the file to the email before sending it.
 
 
 
• **Separate** (अलग करना): To set or keep apart.
 
 
• **Example: **It's important to separate recyclable materials from regular trash.
 
 
 
• **Surrender** (समर्पण करना): To give up or yield, especially in the face of stronger opposition.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers decided to surrender after being surrounded by the enemy forces.
